summary: Declare the source-of-truth ordering (e.g. spec > code > tests > issues > conversation) in the repository instruction file (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) and project profile so both humans and agents resolve conflicts deterministically.

evidence.summary: GitHub Spec Kit: Specify->Plan->Tasks->Implement workflow; spec is the contract/source of truth for agent work; integrates 30+ agents as of 0.11.0 (2026-06).
ADRs create a single durable source of truth per decision; decision log links to PRs/issues for traceability.

context-engineering (public, reputation established): read SKILL.md: 'The Context Hierarchy - structure context from most persistent to most transient' (1. rules files CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, 2. spec/architecture docs, 3. source files, 4. error output, 5. conversation history), with a 'When Context Conflicts' protocol that forbids silently picking an interpretation and requires surfacing the conflict with options - the declared ordering plus conflict-resolution rule the remedy asks to put in the instruction file.

not_for: repos with no written specification at all

risks: The declaration itself must be kept current or it becomes another stale document.
